new_venues.name: Grand Tour Karting (Grand Tour Italia)
new_venues.address: Via Paolo Canali 8, 40127 Bologna (BO)
new_venues.note: Indoor electric kart track inside Grand Tour Italia theme park (ex FICO); coordinates are the park object. Formats: CRONO 10', Corsa GT (8' quali + 8-lap race), Corsa GT Plus, All-you-can-drive Tue/Wed 17-23, Time Attack Thu 17-23; prices not on page. Travel Emilia-Romagna says 500 m, electric karts by Parolin (not on own page).

new_venues.name: Pista Go Kart Acquaparco Migliaro
new_venues.address: Via Sfondrabò 46/A, Borgo Cascina, 44027 Migliaro (Fiscaglia, FE)
new_venues.note: 1300 m own-kart track next to a swimming-pool park; hourly sessions by category (60, monomarcia, KZ), on-site mechanic, races held. No rental karts mentioned. Coordinates are the Via Sfondrabò street object (approximate).

new_venues.name: Pista Salentina - Circuito Internazionale Karting Torre San Giovanni
new_venues.address: SP Pescoluse - Torre San Giovanni, 73059 Torre San Giovanni, Ugento (LE)
new_venues.note: OSM object is highway=raceway without sport=karting (also node/2193169945 leisure=sports_centre). Hosted Rd1 of the 2025 Italian ACI Karting Championship; operating since 1986; floodlit; camper area and rooms on site. Second phone +39 349 274 2614.

new_venues.name: Circuito del Sele

new_venues.note: Multi-use circuit since 1985 (kart 1345 m, moto/auto 1700 m), ACI Karting championship venue 2019; kart rental for adults and two-seaters for children; prices not published. Coordinates approximate: one of several Via Fosso Pioppo street segments (postcode 84091); exact track position not geocoded.

new_venues.name: Circuito Internazionale Il Sagittario
new_venues.address: Via Pontina km 81,300, 04100 Latina (LT)
new_venues.hours: Rental: Mon closed; Tue-Fri 09:00-13:00 and 14:00-20:00 or dark; Sat/Sun/holidays 17:00-20:00 or dark. Own vehicles (1-24 Oct): Mon-Fri 09:00-13:00/14:00-17:30, Sat-Sun 09:00-13:00/14:00-17:00.
new_venues.fees: Insurance membership (tesseramento) EUR 8, 365 days, mandatory for under-16 rental; own karts need ASI C1 membership
new_venues.note: OSM object is highway=raceway (not sport=karting). Multi-use circuit: kart rental, Ohvale minibikes, Legend Cars, own karts/bikes. Track length 1540 m from third-party listings (Yumping), not own site.

new_venues.name: Space Game Val Camonica - Kart (ex Planet Kart)
new_venues.address: Via Saletti 20, Zona Industriale, 25050 Pian Camuno (BS)
new_venues.note: planetkart.it now redirects to Space Game Val Camonica (kart, laser game, bowling). Two-level indoor track plus outdoor extension. new_venues.name: Kart Roma (Pista Kart Roma)
new_venues.address: Via della Muratella 49, 00148 Ponte Galeria, Roma (RM)
new_venues.hours: Mon-Fri 17:00-24:00; Sat 11:00-13:00 and 15:00-24:00; Sun 11:00-13:00 and 15:00-23:00 (outdoor, weather dependent; no bookings)

new_venues.name: PGK Karting Network Pesaro
new_venues.address: Via Toscana 16, 61122 Pesaro (PU)
new_venues.note: Opened 1 Feb 2025; two-level indoor electric track, 650 m, 14 corners + parabolic. Sister of existing PGK Venezia. Coordinates are the Via Toscana street object (Tombaccia), approximate.

new_venues.name: SKindoor - Sardinia Kart Indoor
new_venues.address: Monastir (CA) - street address not published on site
new_venues.hours: From 1 June 2026: Mon-Tue 18:00-22:30; Wed-Sat 18:00-23:30; Sun 18:00-22:00 (Google widget on site shows different hours)
new_venues.note: Self-described largest indoor kart track in Europe, Monastir (CA), ~15 km from Cagliari (Yumping: ~500 m in two connected sheds, 20 Sodi karts). skindoor.it redirects to sardegnakartindoor.com. Prices not found in page text (booking/shop system).
